title: BCR VH sequencing of PBMCs of human subjects prior to and following Tdap vaccination
description: Bulk VH sequencing of 19 subjects prior to and 7 days following Tdap vaccination was performed for the purpose of a computational experiment to identify predictable features of Tdap-induced clonotype expansion.

study_labels.evidence: BCR VH sequencing of PBMCs of human subjects prior to and following Tdap vaccination
